on-surface-dark.reason: One of the five nested-surface names authors write in deck content and fork stylesheets; three of the five happen to have an in-repo user, these two do not, and that says nothing about whether authors use them.

on-surface-accent.reason: Author vocabulary, exactly like on-surface-dark: written by decks and forks, never by this repo's own markup. Removing it is a vocabulary decision, not a dead-code one.

katex-error.reason: Written by vendored KaTeX in its throwOnError:false branch, so the raw LaTeX stays visible when a formula fails to parse.

atrule.reason: Prism token type, emitted as class="token atrule"; defined by the vendored css, scss and swift grammars.

attr-name.reason: Prism token type, emitted as class="token attr-name"; defined by the vendored markup, jsx and graphql grammars.

attr-value.reason: Prism token type, emitted as class="token attr-value"; defined by the vendored markup, jsx and ini grammars.

builtin.reason: Prism token type, emitted as class="token builtin"; defined by the vendored bash, python and ruby grammars.

class-name.reason: Prism token type, emitted as class="token class-name"; defined by the vendored clike, javascript and c grammars.

entity.reason: Prism token type, emitted as class="token entity"; defined by the vendored markup and bash grammars.

operator.reason: Prism token type, emitted as class="token operator"; defined by the vendored clike, cpp and json grammars.

prolog.reason: Prism token type, emitted as class="token prolog"; defined by the vendored markup and markdown grammars.
